summary: Tricky brain test Who is Lying? returns with riddles, mind games, brain games!
description:
Get ready to return to the tricky world of fan favorite Who Is?  Brain Teaser & Tricky Riddles with a brand new chat and clue system! Who is Lying? Who is the killer? and Who is the imposter? Enjoy riddle games and iq tests! This unique iq test comes from the makers of fun-favorite Brain Test: Tricky Puzzles, Brain Test 2: Tricky Stories and Brain Test 3: Tricky Quests. 

Who is 2? Chat Puzzles & Brain Teasers is a brain teaser riddle game with chat simulations. In order to find the answers, you chat with different characters and uncover the clues one by one. With Who is 2? Chat Puzzles & Brain Teasers’s complex dialogue options, you will reveal all kinds of shocking secrets. Find flashback answers to these tricky riddles with one of the popular puzzle games for adults.

Who is 2? Chat Puzzles & Brain Teasers is a completely free riddle and brain teaser game with dozens of levels to play. Tricky characters will try to hide their secrets while players will make them talk like a true chat master. Brain games will get harder and more challenging as you complete the levels filled with tricky riddles and logical puzzles. Play hundreds of amazing jigsaw puzzles for your brain out and exercise with brain games and logic games. If you like IQ games or IQ quizzes you will also find many tricky questions for healthy brain training.

CHAT SIMULATION SYSTEM
Who is 2? Chat Puzzles & Brain Teasers improves the first game’s addicting formula with a state-of-art chat simulation system. In this social role playing system, the characters will reply differently according to your responses. The dialogues are completely player driven as a player can be either a rude or a kind person. The chat system combines brain teaser mechanics with role playing game elements.

MEMORY and TRIVIA PUZZLES
Who is 2? Chat Puzzles & Brain Teasers has a huge variety of puzzle and riddle types. Some levels will test your memory while some will test your knowledge. Trivia questions challenge players with logos of famous brands. You will develop your brain skills and memory power with the challenging memory levels. As always, get ready to be tricked by the brain teasing puzzles.

This mind game offers a great user experience with artistic and funny graphics and animations. You will play a variety of crazy riddles where you solve the problems such as who is a father and who is his wife. You will solve crimes, uncover hidden secrets, and complete complex puzzles by finding clues.

UNCOVER SHOCKING SECRETS
While playing Who is 2? Chat Puzzles & Brain Teasers, you will meet hundreds of different characters. Each character has their own distinct personality. These characters will reveal their secrets if you can convince them with the correct chat responses.

This free mobile game can be played anywhere and anytime. No reflex testing or phone shaking is needed to complete logic game levels. You can relax and enjoy solving our funny tricky riddles for funny brainwash. Stupid test, moron test, or dumb test, all of them are in this brain game.

Features:
● Free to download, free to play and free to enjoy. No hidden fees.
● Chat simulation and RPG levels.
● Deep relationship mechanics and realistic characters.
● Mature chat levels.
● Dozens of levels filled with Tricky & Crazy riddles.
● Choice-based complex scenarios and gameplay.
● Professional graphics and animations.

● A great game to develop brain skills, Brain Go and IQ.
● New puzzles to develop memory muscles.
● Levels filled with brain teaser humor.
● The Skip system allows passing too difficult levels.

● Addictive and relaxing gameplay.

Download Who is 2? Chat Puzzles & Brain Teasers today and start your virtual detective career!
